h: Doris Ogala criticises Nkechi Blessing over her role in the Cross River governor's campaign
p: Nollywood actress Doris Ogala has reportedly criticised fellow actress Nkechi Blessing over the Cross River governor's campaign. The comments have drawn reactions from fans on social media, with some defending Nkechi. Neither side has said more about it.
more: Nkechi Blessing has been in the news recently over her career comments.
Fans are split in the comment sections.
